"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Rental costs escalated so that nearly 12 million families spend more than 50 percent of their incomes on rent.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"The national homeownership rate has sharply fallen.",
